description: Mandated price ceiling on rice (PHP41/kg regular milled; PHP45/kg well-milled)
date_note: Signed 2023-08-31 and announced 2023-09-01 per news; the ceiling took effect 2023-09-05. It was lifted by EO 42, signed 2023-10-04 and released by the PCO on 2023-10-11. The lifting date is the signing date.

description: MFN rice tariff cut from 35% to 15% (in-quota and out-quota)
date_note: Signed 2024-06-20. Rice rates take effect 15 days after publication in the Official Gazette (Sec. 6). The effective date 2024-07-06 is reported, not verified against the Gazette. EO 105 s.2025 keeps 15% to 2025-12-31 and then a variable rate between 15% and 35%.

description: Food security emergency on rice; NFA buffer stock release (~150000 MT over about six months)
date_note: Declared 2025-02-03. The release window was stated as about six months. The effective end 2025-07-31 is that stated window, not an official termination date.

description: Suspension of importation of regular and well-milled rice (60 days)
Extension of the rice import suspension to 2025-12-31
date_note: Signed 2025-10-30. An extension enters a forecast only if announced before that forecast's origin.
